title: Energy Assistance Desk Q&A — Pledges Taken toward Reconnecting Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
These answers set out which energy assistance pledge amount is taken toward reconnecting an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account disconnected for nonpayment. "The month" means dates less than one whole month before the current date; "the latest pledge" is the most recently recorded energy assistance pledge on the service account, and "its agency" is the agency that made it.

**When two or more pledges from the same agency stand in the month, which is taken?** When two or more pledges from the agency of the latest pledge are dated in the month and that agency has paid nothing in the month, only the latest pledge is taken: the later pledge replaces the earlier.

**What if that agency has already paid something this month?** When the agency of the latest pledge has posted payments in the month, the latest pledge less those payments is taken, never below zero.

**And in any other case?** Every pledge dated in the month is taken, added together.

### Selection table

| Pledges from the latest pledge's agency in the month | Payments from that agency in the month | Pledge amount taken |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | None | The latest pledge only |
| Any number | One or more | The latest pledge less those payments, never below zero |
| Fewer than two | None | Every pledge dated in the month |

### Hypothetical cases

| Pledges in the month | Agency payments in the month | Amount taken |
|---|---|---|
| County Emergency Assistance $200.00 on May 3, then $250.00 on May 14 | None | $250.00 |
| LIHEAP $300.00 on May 14 | LIHEAP paid $120.00 on May 18 | $180.00 |
| Salvation Army $75.00 on May 2 and LIHEAP $300.00 on May 14 | None | $375.00 — one pledge from LIHEAP, so every pledge of the month is taken |
